subject: Stiff neck issue: on circular trees & labels

messages.author: 3fa0aae4fa49f8d8
messages.subject: Stiff neck issue: on circular trees & labels
parts:
Dear all,

I have prepared the attached figure to describe the phylogenetic structure of wild bees from the Zanzibar Archipelago vs. Tanzania mainland.

Do you think you could suggest a way to make the tip labels readable without getting a stiff neck? I would like the vertical left half to « mirror » the vertical right half of the labels to make it easier to read.

Here’s the bit of code I have used; I have only slightly edited the legend in Illustrator to get the attached figure.

# Load file

TZ_ZZ = read.csv(file="/Users/nicolasvereecken/Dropbox/PRD 2018-2022/MELIPONICULTURE/ZANZIBAR/Tanzania_Zanzibar.csv", sep=";")

TZ_ZZ_mat = TZ_ZZ[c("Superfamily", "Position", "Family", "Subfamily", "Tribe", "Genus", "Subgenus",  "Concat", 
                    "Nesting", "Sociality", "Pollen.transport", "Tanzania..TZ.", "Zanzibar..ZZ.", "Location")]
TZ_ZZ_mat

# Phylogenetic community structure

library(phytools)
library("ape")
library("Biostrings")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggimage")
# BiocManager::install("ggtree")
library("ggtree")

dev.off()
phylo = as.phylo(~Position/Family/Subfamily/Tribe/Genus/Subgenus/Concat, data=TZ_ZZ_mat)
Tree_phylo = compute.brlen(phylo, power=1)
plot(Tree_phylo, cex=0.5)

# Display nodes

ggtree(Tree_phylo, layout='circular') + 
  geom_tiplab(size=1.7, offset = 0.01, fontface="italic")

ggtree(Tree_phylo, layout='circular') + geom_text(aes(label=node), size=3) + 
  geom_tiplab(size=1.7, offset = 0.01, aes(angle=angle), fontface="italic")

gg = ggtree(Tree_phylo, layout='circular') + geom_text(aes(label=node), size=3) + 
  geom_tiplab(size=1.7, offset = 0.01, aes(angle=angle), fontface="italic")

colgg = c('grey','steelblue','gold','darkred','darkgreen','darkorange')
namesgg = c("Andrenidae","Apidae", "Colletidae", "Halictidae", "Megachilidae", "Melittidae")

Tree_phylo$tip.label = gsub("_", " ", Tree_phylo$tip.label)
TZ_ZZ_mat$Concat = gsub("_", " ", TZ_ZZ_mat$Concat)

GGTREE = ggtree(Tree_phylo, layout='circular') + 
  geom_tiplab(size=1.8, offset = 0.08, aes(angle=angle), fontface="italic") +
  geom_hilight(node=381, fill='steelblue', alpha=0.6, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==381)), shape=21, size=7, fill='steelblue', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_hilight(node=421, fill='darkgreen', alpha=0.6, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==421)), shape=21, size=7, fill='darkgreen', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_hilight(node=455, fill='darkred', alpha=0.6, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==455)), shape=21, size=7, fill='darkred', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_hilight(node=495, fill='gold', alpha=0.6, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==495)), shape=21, size=7, fill='gold', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_hilight(node=453, fill='grey', alpha=0.8, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==453)), shape=21, size=7, fill='grey', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_hilight(node=378, fill='darkorange', alpha=0.6, extend=0.01) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==378)), shape=21, size=7, fill='darkorange', alpha=0.6) 

p1 = set_hilight_legend(GGTREE, colgg, namesgg, alpha=0.6) + theme(legend.position="right") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

TZ_ZZ_mat2 = TZ_ZZ_mat
rownames(TZ_ZZ_mat2) = TZ_ZZ_mat2$Concat
col = c("grey", "black", "red")

p2 = gheatmap(GGTREE, TZ_ZZ_mat2[, "Location", drop=F], offset=.001, width=.05,
              colnames_angle=90, colnames_offset_y = .25) + scale_fill_manual(values=col)

require(cowplot)

leg1 <- get_legend(p1)
leg2 <- get_legend(p2)

pp <- p2 + theme(legend.position="none")
plot_grid(pp, leg1, leg2, ncol=3, rel_widths=c(0.8, 0.1, 0.1))

THANK YOU IN ADVANCE for any help!

Best wishes as always,

Nico
